cohort: A cohort of 73 patients at the Instituto Materno Infantil of Bogota who underwent cesarean section, cesarean with tubal ligation, or tubal ligation alone under spinal anesthesia, excluding those with pre-existing chronic pain or critical conditions.
finding: Postoperative pain increased between 2 and 24 hours after surgery, remaining elevated at 48 hours, with no significant differences in pain levels observed between the three types of procedures.
mod_finding: No significant differences in postoperative pain levels were found between cesarean section, cesarean with tubal ligation, and tubal ligation alone at any measured time point.
